policy: degradation and automatic bypass policy for the on-device DSP graph (mfy-dsp-graph-v1)

rules.condition: any sample peak exceeds headroom linear (10^(-1.0/20) = 0.8913), i.e. above -1.0 dBFS
rules.action: automatic bypass (processor reports inactive at next reconfigure), reason recorded in autoBypassEvents
rules.playback: continues uninterrupted; mid-stream data passes through until reconfigure
rules.restore: DspGraphRuntime.requestRestore() resets processor (next media session starts fresh)
rules.note: conservative protection reserved for future DSP stages; identity graph output == input so the trip is deterministic and harmless

rules.condition: decoder output encoding not in {PCM_8BIT, PCM_16BIT, PCM_24BIT, PCM_32BIT, PCM_FLOAT}
rules.action: UnhandledAudioFormatException; Media3 drops the processor from the chain
rules.playback: continues on the direct path (no DSP), no error surfaced to user

rules.condition: hardware audio offload active while processor installed
rules.policy: mutually exclusive; policy records HARDWARE_OFFLOAD_DISABLED_WHEN_PROCESSOR_ACTIVE; never report both active
rules.evidence: offloadStatus observed UNKNOWN on this device with processor installed; no dual-active claim

rules.policy: 69 ships zero aesthetic DSP parameters; no user DSP controls; UI frozen (3.1)

escalation: any unhandled runtime error in the graph surfaces as PlaybackException (surfaced by PlaybackManager state.error); graph never silently drops audio
next_steps_for_future_packages: true-peak via oversampling before any limiting stage ships (recorded, not implemented)
